model_annotation: This figure shows the outcome training rewards against steps (left), generation length against steps (middle), and entropy against steps (right), in a comparison between on-policy reinforcement learning (blue) and LUFFY (red). The x-axis spans 0 to approximately 700 steps. The y-axis on the left ranges from 0 to 28 and shows outcome training rewards. The middle and right plots share the same x-axis. The y-axis for generation length on the middle plot ranges from 0 to 14 and the y-axis for entropy on the right plot ranges from approximately 1.6 to 2.2. The blue line representing on-policy reinforcement learning starts around 2 and increases to approximately 24 on the left plot, 0 to just below 10 on the middle plot, and 2 to just below 2.2 on the right plot. The red line representing LUFFY starts around 2 and increases to approximately 26 on the left plot, 0 to approximately 6 on the middle plot, and 2 to approximately 2 on the right plot.
